measurement_conditions.dataset_build: not_run; verified existing development SQLite reused
measurement_conditions.memory: /usr/bin/time -l maximum resident set size per process
measurement_conditions.pass_0: first lookups in a fresh process (OS page cache not controlled)
measurement_conditions.passes_1_4: repeated lookups in the same process

metrics: dictionary coverage: inputs with at least one exact or token-normalized match
supported synonym return: inputs whose final terms include a synonym_in_intended_sense or near_synonym
useful return: final terms include synonym/near/alias/abbreviation labels
wrong-sense and related-only rates among final candidates, by relation kind and source
abstention by status; technical unavailability (repository not ready)
expected_any found at dictionary stage vs final stage (missing kept separate from incorrect)
filter attrition per stage/reason; filter loss estimated from the filter-loss sample

original_cohort_selection.rule: words matching ^[a-z]{4,12}$, file_count >= 3 in at least 3 targets, not in the stoplist
original_cohort_selection.source: published repository statistics of the four pinned targets (not the dataset)

review_sampling.interval_rule: ci95=null for a full loss-population census (sample==population); Wilson95 only for an actual uniform partial sample, without FPC. Final census, controls/categories and repeated observations always descriptive.

review_transport.global_queue_read: parent/audit/collector only; labelers read complete assigned graph
review_transport.partition: contiguous greedy in unchanged global review-ID order; shared required files read once per assignment
review_transport.wrapper: formal JSON Schema transport; collector copies original9-field records losslessly

labels.abbreviation_correct: correct abbreviation/expansion for the intended meaning
labels.alias_same_concept: another name of the same concept (product, protocol, pattern)
labels.near_synonym: close in the intended meaning, interchangeable in some code contexts
labels.related_only: related concept, not the same meaning
labels.spelling_or_form_variant: spelling, hyphenation, or inflection variant of the input
labels.synonym_in_intended_sense: interchangeable with the input in its intended code meaning
labels.wrong_sense: valid only for a different sense of the input

rubric.method: Each (input, candidate) pair is labeled against the frozen intended_meaning using only the recorded source evidence (sense gloss, concept, aliases, abbreviation record). Labels are repository-independent; one label per pair.

populations.filter_loss_sample: seeded (seed 20261007) uniform sample of at most 150 unique (case, candidate) pairs that survived normalization in some target but were never final
populations.final_pairs: every unique (case, candidate) that reached final_terms in any target

rubric.uncertainty: Input/target repeats, purposively selected controls and the census of final pairs are descriptive only: ci95 is null, not an independent-trial interval. Dictionary coverage uses unique inputs. Only the uniform filter-loss sample has approximate Wilson 95% intervals (without finite-population correction). Uncertain labels stay separate.
